items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Maxine Sullivan) is narrating a story about Cliff Jackson meeting James P. Johnson. Sullivan states: 'Cliff identified more with James P. Johnson and Fats Waller... ctx.x: Did it give any of the compositions that he was playing?

No, it didn't. It was just a little throwaway, but Cliff told me that when he was about 15, you know, he had been listening to all that jazz; he had stopped taking lessons because he wanted to play jazz and I think he said he was bootlegging at the time, and in Washington they used to have a lot of house parties and he'd stop by late and they were begging him to play with the local big shots out there.
